definitions.gloss: lower grade, lower rank, junior level
definitions.explanation: A lower position in a hierarchy of rank, grade, or class. Used for courts, military, school grades, or organizational levels.

examples.japanese: {下級|かきゅう}⟦{裁判所|さいばんしょ}→裁判所：09665_saibansho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{判決|はんけつ}→判決：05906_hanketsu⟧だ。
{下級|かきゅう}{生|せい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{敬語|けいご}→敬語：04022_keigo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Junior students use polite language with their seniors.

examples.japanese: {下級|かきゅう}⟦{武士|ぶし}→武士：03989_bushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{身分|みぶん}→身分：00278_mibun⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出世|しゅっせ}→出世：08359_shusse⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{藩|はん}→藩：14124_han⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{重臣|じゅうしん}になった。
examples.english: He rose from the status of a low-ranking samurai to become an important retainer of the domain.

notes:
{下級|かきゅう} describes something at the lower end of a ranked hierarchy. It functions as a noun on its own or as a no-adjective modifying another noun.

FORMS:
{下|か} (lower) + ⟦{級|きゅう}→級：28171_kyuu⟧ (grade, rank)

LEVEL SERIES:
- ⟦{上級|じょうきゅう}→上級：11298_joukyuu⟧: upper grade, advanced
- ⟦{中級|ちゅうきゅう}→中級：16955_chuukyuu⟧: intermediate
- {下級|かきゅう}: lower grade, junior

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {下級|かきゅう}⟦{裁判所|さいばんしょ}→裁判所：09665_saibansho⟧: lower court
- {下級|かきゅう}{生|せい}: junior student
- {下級|かきゅう}⟦{武士|ぶし}→武士：03989_bushi⟧: low-ranking samurai
- {下級|かきゅう}{官吏|かんり}: lower-ranking official

USAGE:
Most commonly appears in legal ({下級|かきゅう}⟦{裁判所|さいばんしょ}→裁判所：09665_saibansho⟧), educational, and historical contexts. In modern everyday speech, ⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学年|がくねん}→学年：00056_gakunen⟧ or ⟦{後輩|こうはい}→後輩：02501_kouhai⟧ is more natural than {下級|かきゅう}{生|せい}.
